negative_reviews.author: Kieran Gandhi
negative_reviews.text:
Extremely Disappointing Experience

Absolutely disgusting experience at Maki & Ramen in Southampton today. I have never experienced such poor service, especially when dining with children.

My wife’s food and one of my sons’ meals arrived within a couple of minutes of ordering. Meanwhile, my food and all of our side dishes didn’t arrive until around 29 minutes after we ordered. By that point, my wife and one of my children had already finished eating.

But the worst part was what happened with my two-year-old son.

We specifically ordered a katsu chicken main without the sauce, so he could simply have the chicken and rice. We were told this could instead be ordered as two side dishes. Fine — we agreed. Yet when everyone else’s food eventually arrived, his food had not even been started.

We waited a few more minutes before having to call someone over and ask where his food was. The server checked, and I could clearly see the cook looking through old tickets. It was obvious that the order had simply never been started.

We were then offered his meal for free, but were told we would have to wait for it to actually be cooked. What exactly were we supposed to do? Wait another 20–30 minutes while my food went cold? My son is two years old. This is completely unacceptable.

I asked for further compensation given the situation, and instead of showing any understanding, we were challenged repeatedly about it.

At that point, I was so disgusted and frustrated that I didn’t even eat my own meal. It was taken away, and I left the restaurant having paid for a lunch where I effectively didn’t get to eat.

What makes this even more frustrating is that I noticed other tables around us receiving their food together and being served normally.

I am honestly left wondering whether people who look like me are treated differently in this restaurant. I sincerely hope that isn’t the case, but after today’s experience, I cannot ignore how it felt.

This was supposed to be a family lunch, only a week before my birthday, and instead it turned into an incredibly disappointing and upsetting experience.

The way my two-year-old was treated was particularly disgusting. There was no urgency, no proper explanation and very little empathy.

We will never be coming back to Maki & Ramen. I would strongly encourage the management to look seriously at what happened here, because this is simply not acceptable customer service.
